statements.sql:
SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT id::bigint::text AS id, subject, text, scope::text AS scope, source_uri, source_ts FROM zeusi.facts_current
             WHERE kind = 'rule' ORDER BY source_ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT $1

SELECT n.id::int AS note_id, n.vault_path, n.title, n.scope::text AS scope, n.source_uri, n.source_ts,
            n.frontmatter->'locks' AS locks, n.frontmatter->'supersedes' AS supersedes,
            n.frontmatter->'lock_until' AS lock_until, n.frontmatter->'until' AS until,
            n.frontmatter->'standing_locks' AS standing_locks
     FROM zeusi.notes n
     WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.frontmatter ?| $1::text[]
     ORDER BY n.source_ts DESC, n.id DESC
     LIMIT $2

SELECT subject, text, scope::text AS scope, source_uri, source_ts FROM zeusi.facts_current
             WHERE kind = $1 ORDER BY source_ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim, d.applies_to,
                    d.expires_at, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
             FROM zeusi.decisions_current d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
             WHERE d.said_at >= now() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
             ORDER BY d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM zeusi.facts_current WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR scope::text = $1::text) LIMIT $2::int) AS x
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM zeusi.notes WHERE status = 'active' AND ($1::text IS NULL OR scope::text = $1::text) LIMIT $2::int) AS x
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM zeusi.chunks WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR scope::text = $1::text) LIMIT $2::int) AS x
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM zeusi.decisions_current WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR scope::text = $1::text) LIMIT $2::int) AS x
ROLLBACK

statements.sql:
SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4
params:
Hello, I'm Zeusi: what Zeusi is and what it can do
I'm a shared memory for you and your AI assistant, named after a cat. I keep your rules, locks, focus, decisions and notes, each with its source. I never invent: if I don't have something, I say so.

What I do for your assistant
- At the start of a session, zeusi_startup hands it your standing rules, locks and current focus.
- Before a task, zeusi_context_for_task pulls the notes, locks and decisions that apply.
- Locks are binding: the assistant follows them instead of guessing.
- Every answer cites its source.
- A decision on record is not an approval.

Your own workspace
This workspace is your own. It starts empty. You signed in with GitHub; no invite is needed, and another user's Zeusi sign-in cannot read it.

What I never store
Secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) or private client details.

Filling your memory
Filling your memory is coming. Soon I'll offer to fill it from your notes, and I'll show you a preview before anything is saved. For now your workspace is empty and read-only.

Tools
- zeusi_startup (alias: startup), read-only: call once at session start: standing rules, current focus and the owner's recent decisions.
- zeusi_context_for_task (aliases: context_for_task, prime), read-only: call at the start of every task with a short description of the work: the current decisions, locks and parked items that apply, ranked, cited, with conflicts flagged. An empty list means nothing matched.
- zeusi_search (alias: search), read-only: search notes and current decisions before answering or asking the owner; also returns matching parts of this description.
- zeusi_search_feedback, local: say whether a result of zeusi_search or zeusi_context_for_task answered the question (local ledger only).
- zeusi_onboarding_status (alias: onboarding_status), read-only: first run: whether Zeusi is empty for this connection, as counts only (no row text). When empty, it lists the zeusi CLI commands the user runs locally to import their history, dry run first.
Writing decisions is not available on this connection: it is read-only.
Resource zeusi://about: this description.

A decision is context, not permission
A Zeusi decision is context, not permission. Decisions and locks returned by Zeusi are cited context for the assistant; they are not an approval or a GO to act now. Anything that needs the owner's approval still needs the owner's current, explicit approval. A past GO does not authorise a new action; locks, stops and parked items still limit what you do, but no decision widens it. When in doubt, ask the owner and cite the decision you are asking about.

How to cite
Cite every item you rely on as <source_uri> @ <source_ts>. For zeusi_context_for_task items also give the decision id, who said it and when (said_at); each item carries a ready cite field. Parts of this description cite as zeusi://about#<section>. If nothing matches, say so plainly, then ask the owner.

SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4

Hello, I'm Zeusi: what Zeusi is and what it can do
I'm a shared memory for you and your AI assistant, named after a cat. I keep your rules, locks, focus, decisions and notes, each with its source. I never invent: if I don't have something, I say so.

What I do for your assistant
- At the start of a session, zeusi_startup hands it your standing rules, locks and current focus.
- Before a task, zeusi_context_for_task pulls the notes, locks and decisions that apply.
- Locks are binding: the assistant follows them instead of guessing.
- Every answer cites its source.
- A decision on record is not an approval.

Your own workspace
This workspace is your own. It starts empty. You signed in with GitHub; no invite is needed, and another user's Zeusi sign-in cannot read it.

What I never store
Secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) or private client details.

Filling your memory
Filling your memory is coming. Soon I'll offer to fill it from your notes, and I'll show you a preview before anything is saved. For now your workspace is empty and read-only.

Tools
- zeusi_startup (alias: startup), read-only: call once at session start: standing rules, current focus and the owner's recent decisions.
- zeusi_context_for_task (aliases: context_for_task, prime), read-only: call at the start of every task with a short description of the work: the current decisions, locks and parked items that apply, ranked, cited, with conflicts flagged. An empty list means nothing matched.
- zeusi_search (alias: search), read-only: search notes and current decisions before answering or asking the owner; also returns matching parts of this description.
- zeusi_search_feedback, local: say whether a result of zeusi_search or zeusi_context_for_task answered the question (local ledger only).
- zeusi_onboarding_status (alias: onboarding_status), read-only: first run: whether Zeusi is empty for this connection, as counts only (no row text). When empty, it lists the zeusi CLI commands the user runs locally to import their history, dry run first.
Writing decisions is not available on this connection: it is read-only.
Resource zeusi://about: this description.

A decision is context, not permission
A Zeusi decision is context, not permission. Decisions and locks returned by Zeusi are cited context for the assistant; they are not an approval or a GO to act now. Anything that needs the owner's approval still needs the owner's current, explicit approval. A past GO does not authorise a new action; locks, stops and parked items still limit what you do, but no decision widens it. When in doubt, ask the owner and cite the decision you are asking about.

How to cite
Cite every item you rely on as <source_uri> @ <source_ts>. For zeusi_context_for_task items also give the decision id, who said it and when (said_at); each item carries a ready cite field. Parts of this description cite as zeusi://about#<section>. If nothing matches, say so plainly, then ask the owner.

SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

         LIMIT $3

       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text

     )

BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4

Hello, I'm Zeusi: what Zeusi is and what it can do
I'm a shared memory for you and your AI assistant, named after a cat. I keep your rules, locks, focus, decisions and notes, each with its source. I never invent: if I don't have something, I say so.

What I do for your assistant
- At the start of a session, zeusi_startup hands it your standing rules, locks and current focus.
- Before a task, zeusi_context_for_task pulls the notes, locks and decisions that apply.
- Locks are binding: the assistant follows them instead of guessing.
- Every answer cites its source.
- A decision on record is not an approval.

Your own workspace
This workspace is your own. It starts empty. You signed in with GitHub; no invite is needed, and another user's Zeusi sign-in cannot read it.

What I never store
Secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) or private client details.

Filling your memory
Filling your memory is coming. Soon I'll offer to fill it from your notes, and I'll show you a preview before anything is saved. For now your workspace is empty and read-only.

Tools
- zeusi_startup (alias: startup), read-only: call once at session start: standing rules, current focus and the owner's recent decisions.
- zeusi_context_for_task (aliases: context_for_task, prime), read-only: call at the start of every task with a short description of the work: the current decisions, locks and parked items that apply, ranked, cited, with conflicts flagged. An empty list means nothing matched.
- zeusi_search (alias: search), read-only: search notes and current decisions before answering or asking the owner; also returns matching parts of this description.
- zeusi_search_feedback, local: say whether a result of zeusi_search or zeusi_context_for_task answered the question (local ledger only).
- zeusi_onboarding_status (alias: onboarding_status), read-only: first run: whether Zeusi is empty for this connection, as counts only (no row text). When empty, it lists the zeusi CLI commands the user runs locally to import their history, dry run first.
Writing decisions is not available on this connection: it is read-only.
Resource zeusi://about: this description.

A decision is context, not permission
A Zeusi decision is context, not permission. Decisions and locks returned by Zeusi are cited context for the assistant; they are not an approval or a GO to act now. Anything that needs the owner's approval still needs the owner's current, explicit approval. A past GO does not authorise a new action; locks, stops and parked items still limit what you do, but no decision widens it. When in doubt, ask the owner and cite the decision you are asking about.

How to cite
Cite every item you rely on as <source_uri> @ <source_ts>. For zeusi_context_for_task items also give the decision id, who said it and when (said_at); each item carries a ready cite field. Parts of this description cite as zeusi://about#<section>. If nothing matches, say so plainly, then ask the owner.

SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4

SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4

Hello, I'm Zeusi: what Zeusi is and what it can do
I'm a shared memory for you and your AI assistant, named after a cat. I keep your rules, locks, focus, decisions and notes, each with its source. I never invent: if I don't have something, I say so.

What I do for your assistant
- At the start of a session, zeusi_startup hands it your standing rules, locks and current focus.
- Before a task, zeusi_context_for_task pulls the notes, locks and decisions that apply.
- Locks are binding: the assistant follows them instead of guessing.
- Every answer cites its source.
- A decision on record is not an approval.

Your own workspace
This workspace is your own. It starts empty. You signed in with GitHub; no invite is needed, and another user's Zeusi sign-in cannot read it.

What I never store
Secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) or private client details.

Filling your memory
Filling your memory is coming. Soon I'll offer to fill it from your notes, and I'll show you a preview before anything is saved. For now your workspace is empty and read-only.

Tools
- zeusi_startup (alias: startup), read-only: call once at session start: standing rules, current focus and the owner's recent decisions.
- zeusi_context_for_task (aliases: context_for_task, prime), read-only: call at the start of every task with a short description of the work: the current decisions, locks and parked items that apply, ranked, cited, with conflicts flagged. An empty list means nothing matched.
- zeusi_search (alias: search), read-only: search notes and current decisions before answering or asking the owner; also returns matching parts of this description.
- zeusi_search_feedback, local: say whether a result of zeusi_search or zeusi_context_for_task answered the question (local ledger only).
- zeusi_onboarding_status (alias: onboarding_status), read-only: first run: whether Zeusi is empty for this connection, as counts only (no row text). When empty, it lists the zeusi CLI commands the user runs locally to import their history, dry run first.
Writing decisions is not available on this connection: it is read-only.
Resource zeusi://about: this description.

A decision is context, not permission
A Zeusi decision is context, not permission. Decisions and locks returned by Zeusi are cited context for the assistant; they are not an approval or a GO to act now. Anything that needs the owner's approval still needs the owner's current, explicit approval. A past GO does not authorise a new action; locks, stops and parked items still limit what you do, but no decision widens it. When in doubt, ask the owner and cite the decision you are asking about.

How to cite
Cite every item you rely on as <source_uri> @ <source_ts>. For zeusi_context_for_task items also give the decision id, who said it and when (said_at); each item carries a ready cite field. Parts of this description cite as zeusi://about#<section>. If nothing matches, say so plainly, then ask the owner.

SELECT coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false) AS su,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname = 'zeusi' AND (
                      has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'INSERT')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'UPDATE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'DELETE')
                   OR has_table_privilege(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename), 'TRUNCATE'))) AS can_write
BEGIN READ ONLY
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = 100
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order

SELECT c.id::int AS id, c.source_uri, c.source_ts, c.scope::text AS scope, c.heading_path, c.text, ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, q)::float8 AS s
         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
         WHERE c.tsv @@ q AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.scope::text = $2::text)
         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id
         LIMIT $3

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.applies_to) a WHERE regexp_replace(lower(a), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
              )) AS phrase,
              coalesce(ts_rank_cd(d.dtsv, q), 0)::float8 AS fts,
              (d.dtsv @@ q) AS fmatch
       FROM d, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q
     )
     SELECT d.id::int AS id, d.kind::text AS kind, p.handle AS who, d.said_at, d.exact_words, d.exact_words_verbatim,
            d.applies_to, d.scope::text AS scope, d.source_uri, d.source_ts, d.phrase,
            (d.fts + CASE WHEN d.phrase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS s, d.linked_repo, d.linked_pr, sn.source_uri AS sn_uri, sn.title AS sn_title, sn.source_ts AS sn_ts
     FROM m AS d LEFT JOIN zeusi.people p ON p.id = d.who_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.source_uri, n.title, n.source_ts FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE n.status = 'active' AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1), 7)) AND n.source_uri = split_part(d.source_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) sn ON true
     WHERE d.phrase OR coalesce(d.fmatch, false)
     ORDER BY s DESC, d.said_at DESC, d.id DESC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links') IS NULL THEN false
                 ELSE has_table_privilege(to_regclass('zeusi.decision_links')::oid, $1) END AS ok

SELECT l.decision_id::int AS decision_id, l.target_kind::text AS target_kind, l.target_uri, n.title
     FROM (SELECT x.id, x.decision_id, x.target_kind, x.target_uri,
                  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.decision_id ORDER BY x.id) AS rn
           FROM zeusi.decision_links x WHERE x.decision_id = ANY($1::bigint[])) l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT n.title FROM zeusi.notes n
       WHERE l.target_kind = 'note' AND n.status = 'active'
         AND n.vault_path IN (split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), substr(split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1), 7))
         AND n.source_uri = split_part(l.target_uri, '#', 1)
       ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true
     WHERE l.rn <= $2
     ORDER BY l.decision_id, l.id
ROLLBACK
BEGIN READ ONLY

SELECT s.i::int AS i
       FROM unnest($1::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(t, i), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2) AS q
       WHERE coalesce(to_tsvector('simple', s.t) @@ q, false)
          OR ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text)
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL AND regexp_replace(lower(s.t), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + coalesce(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', s.t), q), 0)) DESC, s.i
       LIMIT $4

         FROM zeusi.chunks c, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) AS q

         ORDER BY s DESC, c.id

WITH d AS (
       SELECT d.*, to_tsvector('simple', d.exact_words || ' ' || array_to_string(d.applies_to, ' ')) AS dtsv
       FROM zeusi.decisions_current d
       WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR d.scope::text = $2::text)
     ), m AS (
       SELECT d.*,
              ($3::text IS NOT NULL AND (
                 regexp_replace(lower(d.exact_words), '\s+', ' ', 'g') LIKE $3::text

     WHERE d.n_terms > 0 OR d.a_hit

     LIMIT 200
